newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kerry Prop mulls US$250 mln bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Kerry Prop mulls US$250 mln bond issue.

text.p: Kerry Properties Ltd said in a statement on Wednesday it was considering a US$250 million convertible bond issue due 2007 to fund property development operations and for corporate purposes.

The bonds would be launched by Kerry Properties Capital Ltd and be convertible into shares of the company. Kerry Properties said it would grant an option for the joint global coordinators to issue a further US$50 million bonds.
Kerry Properties said it would make a further statement after finalising the terms and structure of the issue.
Application would be made to list the bonds in Luxembourg.
Kerry Properties said proceeds would be used to finance a land premium of about HK$817 million for a development in Sham Tseng and to cover development costs at the residential development.
Proceeds would also be used for the development of a new residential project in New Territories, two godowns and its Beijing Kerry Centre and Shanghai Kerry Centre.

The company said its gearing position was about 11 percent as of December 31, 1996. It said it would have sufficient resources to fund its operations in 1997 but its debt was expected to increase due to funding requirements.
Kerry Properties said it would finance funding requirements with internally generated cash flow, unsecured bank financing, secured project financing and debt or equity issues.

The company said its total bank debt outstanding was HK$3.97 billion at the end of 1996 compared with HK$2.19 billion in 1995. It had undrawn banking facilities of about HK$2.37 billion at the end of 1996, it said.
Last month, the company reported 1996 net profit of HK$1.18 billion on a turnover of HK$3.01 billion.
